context: A uni student teases his teen sister at the cafe
purpose: Teach: まとも/ヤツ/アレ/こいつ/トーク/いい加減/どうせ/カン

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おっ、こいつ一人でカフェとか、いつからそんなまともになったんだよ。
lines.en: Oh, look at you alone at a cafe — since when did you become so respectable?
lines.style: Teasing big-brother tone, casual and smirking, drawn-out vowels

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うるさいなあ、お兄ちゃんこそ何しに来たの。変なヤツ。
lines.en: Shut up, what are you even doing here? Weirdo.
lines.style: Annoyed teen girl, sharp and dismissive, slight pout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: アレだろ、お前さっきスマホでニヤニヤしてたやつ、彼氏とのトークだろ。
lines.en: That thing — you were grinning at your phone, chatting with a boyfriend, right?
lines.style: Playful accusing tone, leaning in, mock-detective voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 違うってば!いい加減にしてよ、ただの友達だし。
lines.en: I said no! Cut it out already, she's just a friend.
lines.style: Flustered denial, voice rising, embarrassed and defensive

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どうせ隠したって、俺のカンは鋭いんだよ、妹のことくらい分かる。
lines.en: No matter how you hide it, my intuition is sharp — I know my little sister.
lines.style: Smug confident delivery, slow and teasing, big-brother authority

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はいはい、その妄想おじさんトーク、もう聞きたくないんだけど。
lines.en: Yeah yeah, I don't want to hear your delusional uncle-talk anymore.
lines.style: Cold deadpan teen sass, eye-roll energy, flat tired voice

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おじさんって言うなよ、まだ大学生だぞこっちは。
lines.en: Don't call me uncle, I'm still a college student here.
lines.style: Mock-offended whiny protest, breaking the cool act briefly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ早く帰ってよ、私の昼間の時間返して。
lines.en: Then go home already, give me back my afternoon.
lines.style: Final dismissive shooing tone, pointing at the door playfully
